riskAnalysis: Detached asynchronous route exceptions can terminate Node before report persistence. Abort failed requests without detached throws, preserve every unexpected failure count and safe classification, allow canonical lifecycle closure only when cleanup was explicitly marked, and assert after draining callbacks. Existing redirect credential isolation remains unchanged.
